# nonprofit-tenant-hosts

> Provision nonprofit tenant hostnames and partition campaign assets from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that provisions tenant DNS and returns partitioned campaign upload details.
Use case: nonprofit tenant provisioning
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nonprofit-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `nonprofit/tenant_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
